newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - July 10.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - July 10.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

News Corp announced the sale of its 40 percent stake in PMP Communications Ltd for A$3.20 a share to raise A$325 million on Wednesday, but brokers remain wary of just how much of the 40 percent stake has been distributed to institutional investors and how much of an overhang has yet to be sold.

Australian Vintage Ltd (AustVin) has released its Part B response to a takeover bid by Simeon Wines Ltd, formally recommending shareholders accept the offer and releasing an independent report valuing AustVin shares at between A$2.85 and A$3.13 a share.

Kerry Packer's private company Consolidated Press Holdings, which owns 45 percent of PBL, had raised US$485 million from the sale of its shares in U.S. publisher Valassis, Valassis said on Thursday. The move may renew speculation that Packer is stocking a warchest for a takeover bid for Fairfax once cross-media laws are changed.
Gold miner Normandy Mining Ltd said on Thursday group production rose to a record 410,102 ounces in the quarter to June 30, for annual 1996/97 production of 1.515 million ounces.
